recommendation.reason: hybrid8_then_interleave and hybrid10_then_interleave are tied on every four-book Qwen metric and on every per-question rank in this test. Both beat current hybrid top 20 only on Pride (pp_003 to rank 4, pp_021 to rank 1) and match hybrid on the other three books. Neither 8 nor 10 is better than the other, so 8 is not chosen for being listed first. Either reserved-hybrid rule is the better 20-list than hybrid top 20 alone.
